children.text:
通往北岬矿井的小路穿过珍珠岭腹地的一条狭窄峡谷。你手头的线索寥寥，曾在山谷里四处打听矿井的事，但收集到的只是几种相互矛盾的说法。最近矿里有人失踪，尽管据说采矿作业早已停工。那些地衣和苔藓据称很有营养，可其中有些是致命的？也没人解释过矿井当初究竟为何关闭。

小路尽头是一个豁然张开的大洞口。沿着一条陈旧的铁轨走进去，你发现成堆废弃的设备上长满了亮黄色的真菌。那真菌看上去绝非可食之物，还散发着腐烂的恶臭。隧道最终通入一个巨大的岩穴，里面满是发光的蘑菇和高耸的水晶群。地面随着一阵轻微的震颤而晃动，紧接着矿井深处传来一声回荡的呼喊。你鼓起勇气，继续向洞窟深处跋涉。至少，马奎兹博士一定会想要那些锈蚀设备上奇异增生物质的样本。

children.text:
滑动与交换地点

滑动与交换地点能让调查员通过对齐轨道线，开辟出一条通往轨道出口的路径。

要滑动一个地点，选择一个相邻处有空位的地点。将该地点（以及该地点上的所有卡牌）移入那个空格。

要交换 2 个地点，同时将这两个地点（以及它们上面的所有卡牌）各自移到另一个地点原本占据的空格。

• 带有剧情支援的地点不能被滑动或交换。

specialRules.title: 第 2 幕中的轨道线与相邻

children.text:
每个轨道地点上都印有 1 个或更多轨道图标。这些轨道图标代表矿车行进的轨道。

• 当一个地点上的轨道图标与相邻地点上的轨道图标相对时，这些轨道图标即对齐。

• 轨道图标对齐的相邻地点彼此相连，构成一条轨道线。轨道图标未对齐的相邻地点则彼此不相连。

滑动与交换地点能让调查员通过对齐轨道线，开辟出一条通往轨道出口的路径。

要滑动一个地点，选择一个相邻处有空位的地点。将该地点（以及该地点上的所有卡牌）移入那个空格。

要交换 2 个地点，同时将这两个地点（以及它们上面的所有卡牌）各自移到另一个地点原本占据的空格。

• 带有剧情支援的地点不能被滑动或交换。

每位调查员的迷你卡都叠放在矿车上。

• 位于矿车上的调查员同时也位于矿车所在地点。调查员不能脱离矿车独立移动。矿车移动时，每位调查员都随之移动。

• 矿车剧情支援的右侧印有一个轨道图标，表示它的朝向。矿车的轨道图标必须始终与所在地点的某个轨道图标朝向相同。

• 移动矿车时，它只能沿着轨道线移动到相连的地点。

• 矿车进入一个地点时，调查员可以将其向任一方向旋转 90 度，使其朝向与该地点上的某个轨道图标相同。

• 矿车只能朝其轨道图标所朝的方向移动。如果它移入的地点无法构成完整的轨道线（它们并未对齐），矿车就会脱轨。

矿车

每位调查员的迷你卡都叠放在矿车上。

• 位于矿车上的调查员同时也位于矿车所在地点。调查员不能脱离矿车独立移动。矿车移动时，每位调查员都随之移动。

• 矿车剧情支援的右侧印有一个轨道图标，表示它的朝向。矿车的轨道图标必须始终与所在地点的某个轨道图标朝向相同。

• 移动矿车时，它只能沿着轨道线移动到相连的地点。

• 矿车进入一个地点时，调查员可以将其向任一方向旋转 90 度，使其朝向与该地点上的某个轨道图标相同。

• 矿车只能朝其轨道图标所朝的方向移动。如果它移入的地点无法构成完整的轨道线（它们并未对齐），矿车就会脱轨。

children.text:
如果莉亚·阿特伍德不由调查员控制：

你发现莉亚正低头盯着一汪乳白、发光的液体。你走近时，她抹去眼里的泪水；你请她离开，她却不肯。“这里就是我想待的地方，”她说。你描述了入口处的塌方和眼前的危险。“那些都不重要，”她冷硬地说，但最终还是让步了。你领她走向矿车时，回头看见那炽亮的水潭映出一个圆润的类人形轮廓。它飞快地闪到一块岩石后面。

选择一名调查员控制莉亚·阿特伍德。调查员可以再次触发此法典。

否则：

莉亚打破沉默，一把抓住矿车上损坏的操纵杆。“不是左边！是右边！”矿车在轨道上摇晃，随即恢复平稳。矿车向前疾驰，你与山谷的这位厨师交换了一个如释重负的眼神。

在剧本参考卡上放置 1 个资源，作为道岔。

如果席米恩·阿特伍德不由调查员控制：

矿车摇摇晃晃地驶过一座破败的桥时，你注意到一个瘦小的身影悬挂在悬崖边缘。你凭本能俯身探出矿车边缘，在疾驰而过时抓住那人的前臂。你把他拉进矿车，认出他正是席米恩——山谷里的头号捣蛋鬼。他拍掉身上的灰，脸色白得像纸。“我在找我的私藏。这都是计划的一——”他喘着气说，随即不再解释。“谢谢你救我。没有你，我真不知道该怎么办。”

选择一名调查员控制席米恩·阿特伍德。调查员可以再次触发此法典。

否则：

“不，不，别那样弄。”席米恩扳动矿车上的操纵杆。“你怎么还活着？我真惊讶你居然找到我了。”他拍下隧道侧壁上的一个开关，顽皮地咧嘴一笑。“这才叫会干活。”

在剧本参考卡上放置 2 个资源，作为道岔。

“真巧，在这儿碰见你，”你走近时，瑞玟站起身。他们捧着一只编织篮，里面装得满满的都是发光的蘑菇和血红色的地衣。“跟你说，我的嘴可是很挑的。欧仁妮·布拉齐耶亲手说过，我是光临她餐桌的最挑剔的食客。这些真是绝品，”他们陶醉地从篮子里吸了一口气，然后指了指那条阴森的隧道。“为了爱，我们什么都干得出来。”你提出帮他们采集；毕竟，马奎兹博士一定会想要那些异常增生物的样本。

控制瑞玟·霍桑。如果调查员在关卡结束时同时控制着瑞玟·霍桑和至少 2 [per_investigator] 个线索，记住“你帮助了瑞玟”。

story.title: [codex] 法典 Θ：罗莎·马奎兹博士

children.text:
如果是第 1 幕：

“不知道席米恩在哪儿。莉亚昨晚好像很担心，”马奎兹博士心不在焉地说，一边举起一块白蓝相间的水晶样本。“这些晶簇不是天然形成的。我不是地质学家，但这结构……是扭曲的。其中一些连基本的对称性都没有。”

在剧本参考卡上放置 1 个资源，作为废料。调查员可以在不同的幕中再次触发此法典。

如果是第 2 幕：

“我太老了，受不了这个！”马奎兹博士一边按紧帽子一边吼道。矿车向前疾驰，腐烂的横梁从头顶呼啸而过。穿过黑暗时，教授用手杖拍下旁边的一个开关。矿井更深处，有什么东西在移动。

交换 2 个相邻地点。

story.text: 如果是（白日 [day]），前往 塌方 2。
否则，跳到 塌方 3。
关卡幕间：塌方

塌方 1：轰鸣声渐渐平息，你回头望向坍塌的隧道。已经无路可退。别无他法，你只能沿着陈旧的轨道线走进黑暗。走了不知多久，你来到一间灯火通明的棚屋前，棚屋就挨着附近铁轨上停着的一辆老旧矿车。

查看你的战役日志。

塌方 2：这间棚屋原本是轨道控制站，后来被改作俱乐部活动室。手绘的地图和图表贴满了墙壁与天花板，笔迹看起来出自一个年轻人。如果最近有人来过这里，那人现在也许正和你一起被困在矿井中。

跳到 塌方 4。

塌方 3：一声尖利的颤音在岩穴中回荡，接着是令人作呕的咔嗒声。沿着一条相连的隧道，一张漆黑的巨口嵌在扭动的附肢之间，正朝你逼近。那怪物又发出一串尖利的断音，向你冲来，你的心脏几乎停止跳动。

前往 塌方 4。

塌方 4：入口已经塌陷，离开矿井的唯一办法就是向前。你用尽全身力气推动矿车，然后跳了进去，只盼那些生锈的铁轨撑得住。

children.text:
如果没有达成任何结局（每位调查员都被击败）：你失去意识前记得的最后一件事，是矿车一头冲进光之峡谷。你醒来时头痛欲裂，四周是发光的蓝色真菌和繁复得反常的水晶群。岩壁上有一条向上的小路，但即便只是走回轨道隧道的起点，也要花上好几个小时。你疲惫地叹了口气，涉水穿过地下河。

查看你的战役日志。
如果是 第一夜 或 第二夜，划去席米恩·阿特伍德的名字，跳到 结局 6。
如果是 第一日 或 第二日，跳到 结局 3。
如果是 第三日，跳到 结局 4。

结局 1：席米恩一脸茫然地走出矿车。“真是一场好戏！”他喊道，那副若无其事的样子令人不安。“不管怎么说，你绝对能进矿工秘密捣蛋会的名人堂！你的同伴可都是好人：乔治·华盛顿·卡弗，还有我妈。”轨道向上倾斜通往明亮的天空，他差点绊倒。你扶他站起来，领他走到外面，走进清冽新鲜的空气中。

• 更新你的战役日志。
• 在席米恩·阿特伍德的笔记中记录席米恩幸存。

• 将席米恩·阿特伍德的关系等级提高 2 格。每位调查员获得 2 点奖励经验。

• 跳到 结局 6。

结局 2：你下矿车时，莉亚紧紧抓着车沿。她咬着嘴唇强忍泪水，眼神空洞。你领她沿着隧道往回走，轻柔的哭声在石壁间回荡。走出洞外，来到干净清新的空气中，你鼓起勇气问莉亚看到了什么。

“他走了。席米恩走了，”她答道。

• 更新你的战役日志。
• 在莉亚·阿特伍德的笔记中记录莉亚在矿中看见了什么。

• 提高莉亚·阿特伍德的关系等级。每位调查员获得 2 点奖励经验。

• 跳到 结局 6。

结局 3：你下矿车时，敢肯定自己听到了席米恩·阿特伍德的呼喊在空荡荡的隧道中回荡。那声音让你无法释怀，你折返穿过隧道，希望能找到这个年轻人。你最终来到一处布满水晶的闪亮深渊。一个漆黑的类人身影弓身蹲在一只小动物的尸体上。你出声呼唤，它便飞快地溜进黑暗。你喊席米恩的名字，喊到嗓子沙哑，然后喉咙里堵着可怕的肿块，循原路返回出口。

• 更新你的战役日志。
• 在席米恩·阿特伍德的笔记中记录席米恩失踪。

• 划去席米恩·阿特伍德的名字。

• 跳到 结局 6。

结局 4：你下矿车时，敢肯定自己听到了莉亚·阿特伍德的呼喊在空荡荡的隧道中回荡。那声音让你无法释怀，你折返穿过隧道，希望能找到这位山谷的厨师。你最终来到一处布满水晶的闪亮深渊。一个漆黑的类人身影弓身蹲在深渊底部莉亚的尸体上。你出声呼唤，它便飞快地溜进黑暗。你最后看了莉亚毫无生气的躯体一眼，然后喉咙里堵着可怕的肿块，循原路返回出口。

• 更新你的战役日志。
• 在莉亚·阿特伍德的笔记中记录莉亚与席米恩得以团聚。

• 划去莉亚·阿特伍德的名字。

• 跳到 结局 6。

结局 5：你下矿车时，听见熟悉的、断续的咔嗒声，紧接着是一股腐臭。更多的嚎叫与呼喊在扭曲的岩穴中回荡，促使你向出口跑去。你冲进清朗的夜风中，回头望去，不禁猜想这座岛下的岩层里，还写着哪些别的恐怖。

• 在你的战役日志中记录调查员们从岩间恐怖中幸存。

• 前往 结局 6。

结局 6：“米斯卡托尼克勘察，1926 年 6 月。成员：马奎兹、马斯格雷夫等。我们能活着逃出北岬矿井，实属幸运。极度不稳定与地震颤动。发现包括：不对称的水晶群、体型异常的啮齿动物，以及一群异常凶猛的昆虫。”

• 如果关卡结束时棱柱碎片剧情支援由调查员控制，选择一名调查员将其加入其牌组。它不计入其牌组张数。

• 每位调查员获得等同于胜利区中每张卡牌胜利 X 数值的经验。每位调查员现在可以花费记录在战役日志“未花费经验”下的经验。

仅限独立模式。你脚下的轨道塌陷了。这座矿井根本没有出口，岩壁正在合拢。

当你们中最后一人倒下时，议程上有 [doom] 个毁灭标记。

The path to North Point Mine runs through a narrow ravine in the heart of Pearl Ridge. With little to go on, you asked around the Vale for more information about the mine, but all you could gather were several conflicting accounts. People have gone missing in the mines recently, although the mining operation is purportedly shut down. The lichens and moss are supposedly nutritious, but some are lethal? Nobody explained why the mine shut down in the first place, either.

The path ends at the mouth of a yawning cave. Following an old rail track in, you find heaps of abandoned equipment overgrown with bright yellow fungi. The fungus looks far from edible, and emits a putrescent stench. Eventually, the tunnel opens into a massive cavern filled with luminescent mushrooms and towering crystal formations. The ground shifts with a slight tremor, followed by an echoing cry from deeper in the mine. Steeling yourself, you trek deeper into the cave. At the very least, Dr. Marquez will want samples of the strange overgrowth on the rusted equipment.

Proceed to Setup.

In addition, check the Campaign Log for the current day and gather its corresponding encounter set for The First Day, The Second Day, or The Final Day.

Gather the 6 Cave locations and randomly remove 2 of them from the game. Place the rest as shown in the Location Placement diagram on page 11 (see Location Adjacency on page 3).
Gather each location from the Written in Rock encounter set. Put the Control Station location into play as shown. Set the remaining 15 Rail locations aside, out of play.
Place 1 resource on each location, as a scrap. (Hint: The scraps collected during Act 1 will help investigators during Act 2).
Investigators begin play at the leftmost location.

If it is Day 1, place River Hawthorne at the location in column 3.

Remove the rest of the Residents encounter set from the game.

children.text:
Sliding and Swapping Locations

Sliding and swapping locations allow the investigators to create a path to the Rail Exit by aligning the rail line.

To slide a location, choose a location with an empty space adjacent to it. Move that location (and all cards at that location) into that empty space.

To swap 2 locations, simultaneously move each of those locations (and all cards at them) to the space the other one was occupying.

• Locations with story assets cannot be slid or swapped.

specialRules.title: The Rail Line and Adjacency in Act 2

children.text:
Each Rail location has 1 or more rail icons printed on it. These rail icons represent the track the Mine Cart moves along.

• When a rail icon on one location faces a rail icon on an adjacent location, the rail icons are aligned.

• Adjacent locations with aligned rail icons are connected to each other and form a rail line. Adjacent locations without aligned rail icons are not connected to each other.

Sliding and swapping locations allow the investigators to create a path to the Rail Exit by aligning the rail line.

To slide a location, choose a location with an empty space adjacent to it. Move that location (and all cards at that location) into that empty space.

To swap 2 locations, simultaneously move each of those locations (and all cards at them) to the space the other one was occupying.

• Locations with story assets cannot be slid or swapped.

Each investigator’s mini-card is placed overlapping the Mine Cart.

• An investigator in the Mine Cart is also at its location. Investigators cannot move independently of the Mine Cart. When the Mine Cart moves, each investigator moves with it.

• The Mine Cart story asset has a rail icon on its right side that indicates the direction it is facing. The Mine Cart’s rail icon must always face the same direction as one of its location’s rail icons.

• When moving the Mine Cart, it can only move along a rail line to a connecting location.

• When the Mine Cart enters a location, the investigators may turn it 90 degrees in either direction to face the same direction as a rail icon on that location.

• The Mine Cart can only move in the direction its rail icon is facing. If the location it moves into does not form a complete rail line (they are not aligned), the Mine Cart moves off the rail line.

The Mine Cart

Each investigator’s mini-card is placed overlapping the Mine Cart.

• An investigator in the Mine Cart is also at its location. Investigators cannot move independently of the Mine Cart. When the Mine Cart moves, each investigator moves with it.

• The Mine Cart story asset has a rail icon on its right side that indicates the direction it is facing. The Mine Cart’s rail icon must always face the same direction as one of its location’s rail icons.

• When moving the Mine Cart, it can only move along a rail line to a connecting location.

• When the Mine Cart enters a location, the investigators may turn it 90 degrees in either direction to face the same direction as a rail icon on that location.

• The Mine Cart can only move in the direction its rail icon is facing. If the location it moves into does not form a complete rail line (they are not aligned), the Mine Cart moves off the rail line.

children.text:
If Leah Atwood is not under the control of an investigator:

You find Leah staring down at a pool of milky, glowing liquid. She brushes tears from her eyes as you approach, and resists when you ask her to leave. “This is where I want to be,” she says. You describe the cave-in at the entrance, and the present danger. “None of it matters,” she says stonily, but eventually relents. As you lead her to the cart, you turn and see a round, humanoid shape outlined against the incandescent pool. It flits quickly behind a rock.

Choose an investigator to take control of Leah Atwood. An investigator may trigger this codex again.

Otherwise:

Leah breaks her silence to grab the cart’s broken lever. “Not left! Right!” The cart wobbles on the tracks, then rights itself. You share a look of relief with the Vale cook as the cart careens forward.

Place 1 resources on the scenario reference card, as switches.

If Simeon Atwood is not under the control of an investigator:

As the mine cart judders over a rickety bridge, you notice a small figure dangling from the edge of a precipice. Acting on instinct, you lean down the lip of the mine cart and catch the figure by the forearm as you hurtle past. As you pull him into the cart, you recognize him as Simeon, chief mischief-maker of the Vale. He brushes himself off, cheeks white as paper. “I was looking for my stash. All part of the p—” he wheezes, then gives up. “Thanks for saving me. I don’t know what I would’ve done without you.”

Choose an investigator to take control of Simeon Atwood. An investigator may trigger this codex again.

Otherwise:

“No, no, don’t do it like that.” Simeon pulls the lever on the cart. “How are you still alive? I’m surprised you even found me.” He hits a switch at the side of the tunnel and grins rakishly. “That’s how it’s done.”

Place 2 resources on the scenario reference card, as switches.

“Fancy seeing you here,” River stands as you approach. They hold a woven basket filled to the brim with phosphorescent mushrooms and blood-red lichens. “I have quite the discerning palate, let me tell you. Eugénie Brazier herself said that I was the most demanding patron to grace her table. These are exquisite,” they inhale from their basket luxuriously, then gesture at the grim tunnel. “The things we do for love.” You offer to help them forage; after all, Dr. Marquez will want samples of the unusual growths.

Take control of River Hawthorne. If investigators end the scenario with both River Hawthorne and at least 2 [per_investigator] clues under their control, remember that “you helped River.”

If it is Act 1:

“I wonder where Simeon is. Leah seemed so worried last night,” Dr. Marquez says distractedly as she holds up a sample of a white and blue crystal. “These formations aren’t natural. I’m no geologist, but the formation is…warped. Some of these lack basic symmetry.”

Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as a scrap. An investigator may trigger this codex again during a different act.

If it is Act 2:

“I’m getting too old for this!” Dr. Marquez bellows as she holds onto her hat. Rotting beams whiz by overhead as the mine cart careens forward. The professor hits a nearby switch with her cane as you zoom through the darkness. Somewhere deeper in the mine, something moves.

Swap 2 adjacent locations.

story.text: If it is (Day [day]), proceed to The Cave-In 2.
Otherwise, skip to The Cave-In 3.
Scenario Interlude: The Cave-In

The Cave-In 1: As the rumbling subsides, you look back at the collapsed tunnel. There is no way back. With no other recourse, you follow the old rail line into the darkness. After some time, you come upon a brightly lit shed next to an old mine cart on the nearby tracks.

Check your Campaign Log.

The Cave-In 2: The shed is a former rail control station repurposed as a clubhouse. Hand-drawn maps and charts cover the walls and ceiling; they appear to be a young person’s handwriting. If someone was here recently, they may currently be trapped in the mine along with you.

Skip to The Cave-In 4.

The Cave-In 3: A sharp trill echoes through the cavern, followed by a noisome clicking. Down a connecting tunnel, a stygian maw nested in writhing appendages advances. Your heart nearly stops as the monstrosity lets out another shrill staccato and charges toward you.

Proceed to The Cave-In 4.

The Cave-In 4: With the entrance collapsed, the only way out of the mine is through. You push the mine cart forward with every ounce of your strength and jump in, hoping the rusted tracks hold up.

• Gather all 15 set-aside Rail locations.
• Place the Rail Exit and the 7 depicted Rail Tunnel locations as shown in the Location Placement diagram.

• Shuffle the remaining Rail locations and place 1 in each space marked with a “?” on the Location Placement diagram.

• Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as a switch.

• Place the set-aside Mine Cart asset at the Control Station and choose which direction it is facing (see Sliding and Swapping Locations and The Mine Cart on page 11).
• Place each investigator mini-card in the Mine Cart.

• If either Simeon Atwood or Leah Atwood are set aside, place them at the topmost location in column 2.

• Place the set-aside Prismatic Shard asset at the bottom location in column 4.

• If it is (Night [night]), place the set-aside Subterranean Beast enemy at the Control Station, exhausted.

• Shuffle the remaining set-aside Written in Rock encounter cards and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

• Resume playing.

children.text:
If no resolution was reached (each investigator was defeated): The last thing you remember before you are knocked unconscious is the cart careening into a canyon of light. Your head pounds as you awaken surrounded by glowing blue fungus and extravegant crystal formations. There is a path up the rock, but it will take hours to trek back even to the beginning of the rail tunnels. You sigh, exhausted, and wade through the underground river.

Check your Campaign Log.
If it is Night 1 or Night 2, cross out Simeon Atwood’s name and skip to Resolution 6.
If it is Day 1 or Day 2, skip to Resolution 3.
If it is Day 3, skip to Resolution 4.

Resolution 1: Simeon steps out of the mine cart looking dazed. “What a ride!” he shouts, troublingly unfazed. “No matter what, you are definitely going in the Miner’s Secret Order of Mischief ’s Hall of Fame! You’re in good company with George Washington Carver and my mom.” He nearly trips as the rail line slopes upward, toward the brilliant sky. You help him to his feet and lead him outside, into the clear fresh air.

• Update your Campaign Log.
• In Simeon Atwood’s Notes, record Simeon survived.

• Increase Simeon Atwood’s Relationship Level by 2. Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience.

• Skip to Resolution 6.

Resolution 2: Leah grips the side of the cart as you disembark. She bites her lip as she holds back tears, unseeing. As you lead her back up the tunnel, the sound of soft weeping echoes off the stone walls. As you emerge outside into the clean, fresh air, you work up the courage to ask Leah what she saw.

“He’s gone. Simeon’s gone,” she replies.

• Update your Campaign Log.
• In Leah Atwood’s Notes, record Leah saw something in the mine.

• Increase Leah Atwood’s Relationship Level. Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience.

• Skip to Resolution 6.

Resolution 3: You could swear you hear Simeon Atwood’s voice calling through the empty tunnels as you disembark. Unable to shake the sound, you double back through the tunnels in hopes of finding the young man. You eventually come to a shining abyss filled with crystals. A dark humanoid shape sits hunched over the carcass of a small animal. It skitters into the dark when you call. You shout Simeon’s name until your voice is hoarse, then retrace your steps to the exit with an awful lump in your throat.

• Update your Campaign Log.
• In Simeon Atwood’s Notes, record Simeon disappeared.

• Cross out Simeon Atwood’s name.

• Skip to Resolution 6.

Resolution 4: You could swear you hear Leah Atwood’s voice calling through the empty tunnels as you disembark. Unable to shake the sound, you double back through the tunnels in hopes of finding the Vale cook. You eventually come to a shining abyss filled with crystals. A dark humanoid shape sits hunched over Leah’s body at the bottom. It skitters into the dark when you call. You take one last look at Leah’s lifeless body, then retrace your steps to the exit with an awful lump in your throat.

• Update your Campaign Log.
• In Leah Atwood’s Notes, record Leah and Simeon were reunited.

• Cross out Leah Atwood’s name.

• Skip to Resolution 6.

Resolution 5: You hear a familiar chittering staccato as you disembark, followed by a scent of rot. More howls and shouts echo through the twisted cavern, prompting you to run to the exit. Once you emerge into the clear night air, you turn back and wonder what other terrors are written in rock beneath the island.

• In your Campaign Log, record the investigators survived the horrors in the rock.

• Proceed to Resolution 6.

Resolution 6: “Miskatonic Survey, June 1926. Members Marquez, Musgrave, et alii. We were lucky to escape from North Point Mine with our lives. Extreme instability and seismic tremors. Findings include asymmetrical crystal formations, rodents of unusual size, and an unusually aggressive insect population.”

• If the Prismatic Shard story asset was under the control of an investigator when the scenario ended, choose an investigator to add it to their deck. It does not count toward their deck size.

• Update your Campaign Log.
• If “you helped River,” increase River Hawthorne’s Relationship Level. Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience.

• If an investigator controls River Hawthorne and the above is not true: Decrease River Hawthorne’s Relationship Level.

• Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display. Each investigator may now spend the experience recorded under “Unspent Experience” in your Campaign Log.

• In the “Areas Surveyed” section of your Campaign Log, check off North Point Mine.

• Check your Campaign Log.
• If it is Day 1, turn to Prelude: The First Evening (page 31).

• If it is Night 1, turn to Prelude: Dawn of the Second Day (page 39).

• If it is Day 2, turn to Prelude: The Second Evening (page 43).

• If it is Night 2, turn to Prelude: Dawn of the Final Day (page 51).

• If it is Day 3, turn to Prelude: The Final Evening (page 55).
